content: The continuous use of real-time continuous glucose monitoring (rtCGM) in children and adolescents with type 1 diabetes has demonstrated significant improvements in blood glucose management. This often correlates with enhanced psychological outcomes for these patients. Clinical trials have shown that rtCGM reduces the stress associated with glucose management for both young patients and their parents. This reduction in stress contributes to better adherence to diabetes management protocols. Additionally, the use of rtCGM has been associated with a decrease in hemoglobin A1c levels and fewer episodes of hypoglycemia, indicating improved overall diabetes control.
